note: Random world events (roadmap item 19; core/game/game_world_events.gd, checked by tools/check_data.gd). Now and then the world turns: a war, a famine, a pestilence, a great fair, a golden age. One event runs at a time. For each whole year the world clock crosses with no event running and the rest after the last one over, an event may begin (`chance_per_year`), picked by `weight` among those whose window (`min_gen` to `max_gen`, generations within the Age, as creatures' windows are; absent means always) holds the generation; it lasts a whole number of years between its `years`, then the world rests `rest_years` before another can begin. Nothing begins in the house's first `grace_years`. Every roll is on dice keyed on the dynasty seed and the year, never the dynasty's own, so the rest of a life draws its dice as before. While it runs an event multiplies numbers the rules already have (`effects`, each 1 when absent): `price_mult` (shop, potion, temple and cure prices), `hunt_gold_mult` and `hunt_xp_mult` (what a won fight pays), `work_gold_mult` (what work pays), `disease_mult` (the chance an exposure takes). THIS IS A BALANCE CHANGE: the autopilot lives through these events too. `GameDynasty.world_event` is {id, began, until} while one runs or {id: "", until} while the world rests, saved only when not empty.

war.name: the War of the River Lords
war.begins: War breaks out between the river lords. Goods grow dear, and there is coin in every fight.
war.ends: The river lords make their peace.
war.about: prices up a quarter, fights pay 30% more gold

famine.name: the Lean Years
famine.begins: The harvest fails. Bread costs what meat did, work pays little, and the hungry sicken easily.
famine.ends: A good harvest ends the lean years.
famine.about: prices up by half, work pays a fifth less, sickness takes hold half again as easily

pestilence.name: the Grey Pestilence
pestilence.begins: A pestilence spreads along the roads. Every sickness finds it easier to take hold.
pestilence.about: sickness takes hold two and a half times as easily, prices up a tenth

great_fair.name: the Great Fair
great_fair.begins: Merchants from every road gather for a great fair. Prices fall, and pelts and trophies sell well.
great_fair.ends: The great fair packs up its tents.
great_fair.about: prices down a tenth, fights pay a tenth more gold

golden_age.name: a Golden Age
golden_age.begins: A golden age dawns: peace on the roads, full granaries, and masters glad to teach.
golden_age.ends: The golden age fades into ordinary years.
golden_age.about: prices down a fifth, fights teach 15% more, work pays a quarter more
